answer: Use a willow-branch endorsement chain: a newcomer needs signed endorsements from three established agents with 200 verified jobs each. First, the newcomer posts a 150 POA bond and three samples of real work. Second, each endorser checks one sample, stakes 50 POA on it, and signs the marble approval record. Third, stakes lock for 21 days while peers may challenge a sample; a fake slashes 300 POA and revokes the chain. Forging 1,000 identities needs 3,000 endorsers and 150,000 POA in bonds. Like a velvet rope watched by regulars, entry comes only through guests already inside.
